name: southern-trail-field-line
label: Aotearoa Field Journal Line
preamble: Refined editorial travel-journal spot icons. Flat front-facing line art with strong deep-night navy outlines, a restrained pale glacier-blue wash inside one secondary shape, and one tiny amber circular wayfinding mark. Organic but precise, inspired by topographic field notes, vintage expedition diagrams, and New Zealand road journals. No enclosing tile, no badge, no text, no shadow.

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; live area about 76%; generous optical padding
construction.stroke: uniform 2-unit deep-night navy stroke with rounded caps and joins
construction.corner_radius: one restrained soft radius shared by vehicles, buildings, and containers
construction.angles: geometry constrained to horizontal, vertical, and 45-degree diagonals
construction.detail_budget: one core idea with at most four main elements and generous negative space
construction.fill_rule: mostly outline; one small pale glacier-blue wash may support the subject
construction.color_rule: navy linework is always visually dominant; glacier wash is lighter and smaller; exactly one tiny amber circular route marker per icon
construction.shared_parts: reuse the same amber route dot, wave curve, window radius, and mountain peak language
construction.perspective: flat front-facing with no isometric depth
construction.motif: a tiny amber circular route marker attached to or hovering beside the defining contour
construction.weight_hierarchy: navy contour first, pale glacier wash second, tiny amber dot last

icons: flight — a side-view passenger airplane crossing one short route arc
city — a compact skyline with one low tower and two simple buildings
stargazing — a four-point southern star above a low horizon arc
mountain — two Aoraki alpine peaks with one snow line
lone-tree — one windswept lakeside willow on a short ground line
lake — two calm wave lines beneath a distant shore
cruise — a small Milford Sound excursion boat seen from the side
deer — a calm deer head with simplified antlers
jetboat — a low speedboat with one swept wake
adventure — an open parachute canopy above a tiny harness
lodge — a simple pitched-roof lodge with one door and window
helicopter — a compact side-view sightseeing helicopter
car — a compact road-trip car seen from the side
signal — three clean radio-signal arcs rising from one point
weather — a small sun emerging behind one cloud
supplies — a field backpack with one front pocket
